caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a male figure standing upright. The figure is wearing a dark brown wide-brimmed hat with black shading, a black jacket with gold buttons, a beige vest or shirt underneath, and reddish-brown trousers with lighter patches showing wear at the knees. The figure’s hands are clenched, and he appears to be holding a thin, black object spanning both hands at waist level. The facial features, including eyes, nose, and mouth, are clearly defined with dark lines and shading, and long dark hair extends down from underneath the hat. The statue also wears light-colored shoes with rectangular buckles. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and the figure is centered in the composition.
title: Figure of a Felon
